title: Unit 1 | Greetings and People
study_tip: Say each new word three times aloud, then use it in a sentence about your own life.

words.definition_en: a word you say when you meet someone.
words.example: Hello, my name is Anna.

words.definition_en: a word you say when you leave.
words.example: Goodbye! See you tomorrow.

words.definition_en: a person you like and know well.
words.example: My friend lives next door.

words.definition_en: the word people call you.
words.example: What is your name?

words.definition_en: a person who helps you learn at school.
words.example: The teacher writes on the board.

words.definition_en: a person who studies at school or university.
words.example: She is a student at a big school.

words.definition_en: a person who lives near you.
words.example: Our neighbour has a small dog.

words.definition_en: a polite word used when you ask for something.
words.example: Can I have some water, please?

words.definition_en: a word you say to show you are grateful.
words.example: Thanks for your help.

words.definition_en: to greet a guest in a friendly way.
words.example: We welcome you to our home.

title: Unit 2 | Family
study_tip: Write new words on small cards: the word on one side, the meaning on the other.

words.definition_en: your female parent.
words.example: My mother cooks dinner every night.

words.definition_en: your male parent.
words.example: My father drives to work.

words.definition_en: a girl who has the same parents as you.
words.example: My sister is two years older than me.

words.definition_en: a boy who has the same parents as you.
words.example: My brother plays football.

words.definition_en: the mother of your mother or father.
words.example: My grandmother tells great stories.

words.definition_en: the father of your mother or father.
words.example: My grandfather has a big garden.

words.definition_en: the brother of your mother or father.
words.example: My uncle visits us at Christmas.

words.definition_en: the sister of your mother or father.
words.example: My aunt lives in Spain.

words.definition_en: the child of your uncle or aunt.
words.example: My cousin is the same age as me.

words.definition_en: a very young child.
words.example: The baby is sleeping now.

title: Unit 3 | Food and Drink
study_tip: Group words by topic. Your brain remembers connected words more easily.

words.definition_en: a food made from flour and baked.
words.example: I eat bread with butter for breakfast.

words.definition_en: a yellow or white food made from milk.
words.example: Do you want cheese on your pizza?

words.definition_en: a round fruit that is red, green or yellow.
words.example: She eats an apple every day.

words.definition_en: small white grains that you cook and eat.
words.example: We have chicken and rice for lunch.

words.definition_en: a hot liquid food.
words.example: The soup is too hot to eat.

words.definition_en: a bird kept for its meat and eggs.
words.example: My mother cooks chicken on Sundays.

words.definition_en: a plant you eat, such as a carrot.
words.example: Carrots are my favourite vegetable.

words.definition_en: a drink made from fruit.
words.example: I would like orange juice, please.

words.definition_en: wanting to eat food.
words.example: I am hungry because I missed lunch.

words.definition_en: tasting very good.
words.example: This cake is delicious!

title: Home and Rooms
study_tip: Review new words after 1 day, 3 days, 1 week and 1 month (spaced repetition).

words.definition_en: the room where you cook food.
words.example: We cook dinner in the kitchen.

words.definition_en: the room where you sleep.
words.example: My bedroom has a small window.

words.definition_en: the room where you wash.
words.example: There is a shower in the bathroom.

words.definition_en: a place outside a house with grass and flowers.
words.example: The children play in the garden.

words.definition_en: a glass opening in a wall.
words.example: Please open the window.

words.definition_en: something you open to enter a room.
words.example: Close the door when you leave.

words.definition_en: a soft seat for two or three people.
words.example: We watch TV on the sofa.

words.definition_en: a piece of furniture with a flat top.
words.example: The plates are on the table.

words.definition_en: a seat for one person.
words.example: He sits on a hard chair.

words.definition_en: a light you can move from place to place.
words.example: Turn on the lamp, it is dark.

title: Daily Routines
study_tip: Learn the whole phrase, not just the word: note which words usually go with it.

words.definition_en: to stop sleeping.
words.example: I wake at seven o'clock every day.

words.definition_en: to clean with water.
words.example: I wash my face in the morning.

words.definition_en: to put clothes on.
words.example: The children dress before breakfast.

words.definition_en: to clean with a brush.
words.example: Brush your teeth twice a day.

words.definition_en: to learn about a subject.
words.example: I study English after dinner.

words.definition_en: to prepare food with heat.
words.example: My dad likes to cook on Saturdays.

words.definition_en: to remove dirt from a place.
words.example: We clean the house on Sunday.

words.definition_en: to rest with your eyes closed at night.
words.example: Babies sleep a lot.

words.definition_en: to rest and feel calm.
words.example: I relax with a book in the evening.

words.definition_en: to go away from a place.
words.example: I leave home at eight o'clock.

title: Time and Days
study_tip: Try to use each new word in a short conversation or message today.

words.definition_en: the early part of the day.
words.example: I drink coffee in the morning.

words.definition_en: the time between lunch and evening.
words.example: We play football in the afternoon.

words.definition_en: the time between afternoon and night.
words.example: We eat dinner in the evening.

words.definition_en: a period of seven days.
words.example: There are seven days in a week.

words.definition_en: on this day.
words.example: Today is Monday.

words.definition_en: on the day after today.
words.example: I will see you tomorrow.

words.definition_en: on the day before today.
words.example: Yesterday it rained all day.

words.definition_en: Saturday and Sunday.
words.example: We go to the beach at the weekend.

words.definition_en: one of the twelve parts of a year.
words.example: January is the first month of the year.

words.definition_en: the day each year when you were born.
words.example: Her birthday is in May.

title: Unit 7 | Clothes and Shopping
study_tip: Draw a quick picture next to a word. Images help memory.

words.definition_en: a short coat.
words.example: Take a jacket, it is cold outside.

words.definition_en: clothing that covers your legs.
words.example: These trousers are too long for me.

words.definition_en: a long piece of cloth worn around the neck.
words.example: She wore a warm scarf in winter.

words.definition_en: a small bag sewn into clothes.
words.example: I put my keys in my pocket.

words.definition_en: costing a lot of money.
words.example: That watch is too expensive for me.

words.definition_en: costing little money.
words.example: The tickets were cheap, only five euros.

words.definition_en: a person who buys things in a shop.
words.example: The customer asked for a bigger size.

words.definition_en: a paper that shows you paid for something.
words.example: Keep the receipt in case you want to return it.

words.definition_en: a reduction in the usual price.
words.example: They give a ten percent discount to students.

words.definition_en: to be the right size for someone.
words.example: This shirt does not fit me.

title: Unit 8 | Travel and Transport
study_tip: Notice the part of speech: knowing noun, verb or adjective helps you use it correctly.

words.definition_en: an official document that lets you travel to other countries.
words.example: Don't forget your passport at the airport.

words.definition_en: a piece of paper that lets you travel or enter a place.
words.example: I bought a train ticket online.

words.definition_en: the bags you take when you travel.
words.example: Our luggage was very heavy.

words.definition_en: a place where planes arrive and leave.
words.example: We arrived at the airport two hours early.

words.definition_en: the place in a station where you get on a train.
words.example: The train leaves from platform four.

words.definition_en: a trip from one place to another.
words.example: The journey to the coast takes three hours.

words.definition_en: a time when something happens later than planned.
words.example: There was a long delay because of the fog.

words.definition_en: an arrangement to keep a room or table for you.
words.example: I made a reservation at the hotel.

words.definition_en: a person who visits a place on holiday.
words.example: The tourist took photos of the old castle.

words.definition_en: a drawing of an area that shows roads and places.
words.example: We used a map to find the museum.

title: Unit 9 | Weather and Seasons
study_tip: Read a short text on this topic and underline the new words you meet.

words.definition_en: with a lot of sun.
words.example: It is a sunny day, let's go outside.

words.definition_en: covered with clouds.
words.example: The sky is cloudy this morning.

words.definition_en: with a lot of wind.
words.example: It was too windy to fly a kite.

words.definition_en: with a lot of rain.
words.example: Bring a coat on a rainy day.

words.definition_en: very bad weather with strong wind and rain.
words.example: The storm broke several trees.

words.definition_en: how hot or cold something is.
words.example: The temperature fell below zero last night.

words.definition_en: extremely cold.
words.example: It is freezing outside, so wear gloves.

words.definition_en: an object that keeps rain off you.
words.example: Take an umbrella because it may rain.

words.definition_en: a report about what the weather will be.
words.example: The forecast says snow tomorrow.

words.definition_en: one of the four parts of the year.
words.example: Summer is my favourite season.

title: Unit 10 | Body and Health
study_tip: Test yourself by covering the meaning column and recalling each definition.

words.definition_en: a pain in your head.
words.example: I have a headache, so I am going to lie down.

words.definition_en: a high body temperature when you are ill.
words.example: The child has a fever and needs rest.

words.definition_en: to push air out of your throat with a noise.
words.example: He began to cough at night.

words.definition_en: something you take to get better.
words.example: Take this medicine twice a day.

words.definition_en: a shop that sells medicine.
words.example: The pharmacy closes at six.

words.definition_en: a planned time to see a doctor.
words.example: I have an appointment at ten.

words.definition_en: good for your body.
words.example: Fruit is a healthy snack.

words.definition_en: physical activity that keeps you fit.
words.example: Daily exercise is good for your heart.

words.definition_en: needing rest or sleep.
words.example: I feel tired after the long walk.

words.definition_en: the part of your body where food goes.
words.example: My stomach hurts after dinner.

title: Unit 11 | Hobbies and Free Time
study_tip: Say each new word three times aloud, then use it in a sentence about your own life.

words.definition_en: something you enjoy doing in your free time.
words.example: My hobby is photography.

words.definition_en: to gather things you like.
words.example: He likes to collect old coins.

words.definition_en: to make a picture with colours.
words.example: She likes to paint landscapes.

words.definition_en: a live music performance.
words.example: We went to a concert last night.

words.definition_en: a place where you do exercise.
words.example: I go to the gym after work.

words.definition_en: the sport of moving through water.
words.example: Swimming is good for your back.

words.definition_en: to ask someone to come to an event.
words.example: I want to invite you to my party.

words.definition_en: a game between two teams.
words.example: The match starts at three.

words.definition_en: a picture made with a camera.
words.example: This photograph shows our trip to Rome.

words.definition_en: a special event with music or food.
words.example: The town has a music festival every summer.

title: Unit 12 | Town and Directions
study_tip: Write new words on small cards: the word on one side, the meaning on the other.

words.definition_en: the place where two streets meet.
words.example: Turn left at the corner.

words.definition_en: a place where two roads cross.
words.example: Stop at the crossroads and look both ways.

words.definition_en: a structure that lets you cross a river.
words.example: The bridge connects the two parts of town.

words.definition_en: cars and other vehicles on a road.
words.example: The traffic is terrible at eight o'clock.

words.definition_en: the path at the side of a road.
words.example: Walk on the pavement, not in the road.

words.definition_en: in a line without turning.
words.example: Go straight for two hundred metres.

words.definition_en: on the other side of.
words.example: The bank is opposite the post office.

words.definition_en: close to where you are.
words.example: Is there a bank nearby?

words.definition_en: the way you go to reach a place.
words.example: We went in the wrong direction.

words.definition_en: an area of houses on the edge of a city.
words.example: They live in a quiet suburb.
